title: ReachEscalationPendingFeedbackSignal
description: FeedbackSignal kind emitted by doorway when a republished EprHead carries a reach value above its projection's existing reach. The doorway pauses serving the projection until an acknowledges-reach-change Commitment is published. Source of truth: Holochain DHT (elohim zome's existing FeedbackSignal entry type via signal_kind vocabulary; no new DHT entry type). Canon: genesis/docs/architecture/stewardship-over-sovereignty.md §6 rule 3. Spec: Z.D §3 soft-warn ceremony.

target.description: CID of the new EprHead whose reach exceeds the existing projection.

declarer.description: Agent identifier of the doorway service-agent that paused the projection.

projection_commitment.description: CID of the project-epr Commitment whose projection is paused.
